Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 - Bush Rescue.name: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue
Ty the Tasmanian Tiger 2 - Bush Rescue.summary: STREWTH! It's time to go back Down Under with this fully remastered version of TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue. Rang, bite, smash and glide your way around the Australian Outback and stop the evil machinations of the diabolical BOSS CASS in this open world adventure.

Zoids - Full Metal Crash.name: Zoids: Full Metal Crash
Zoids - Full Metal Crash.summary: Zoids: Full Metal Crash is an Action game, developed and published by Tomy Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2005.
